subject: Pilot: dataset & prompt-pack exchange — MAP and ephemeral access
messages:
From: Jay Hayes <jay.hayes@acme.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Anand <priya@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot data exchange — sample logs & prompt packs

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The Acme ML team is excited to run a short pilot to validate inference throughput and quality on our customer-support transcript use case.

We can share a redacted sample of our transcripts (roughly ~50k lines) and a small prompt pack with expected system/user instruction pairs. Our compliance group requires: ephemeral access, audit logs, and a mutual action plan that spells out deletion timelines and allowed usage.

Can Redwood provide a MAP + a secure transfer option (SFTP or signed-presigned S3) and a proposed 4-week close timeline? We can sign the standard NDA — attaching the licensing contact to this thread.

Attachments: acme_redacted_log_sample.csv (stub)

Thanks,
Jay
Jay Hayes
Head of ML Platforms, Acme Corp
jay.hayes@acme.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Jay Hayes <jay.hayes@acme.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot data exchange — sample logs & prompt packs

Hi Jay — great to hear.

Summary of what we can commit to for the pilot (first-pass MAP):
- Scope: ingest redacted transcripts + prompt pack (no PII) into an ephemeral sandbox.
- Duration: 4 weeks of access (configurable); 30 days for audit review, then deletion unless extended.
- Access model: time-limited pre-signed S3 links or one-time SFTP session; we also offer ephemeral tenant in our Dedicated sandbox for higher isolation.
- Auditing: request/response logs retained for 30 days; can provide token-level usage reports and TTL for KV caches.
- Usage constraints: data used solely for pilot evaluation (quality/latency); no derivative dataset creation or external redistribution.

Action items I propose this week:
1) Redwood to send MAP draft + transfer instruction (MAP-draft-20261127.pdf) — attached.
2) Acme to confirm chosen transfer method and sign NDA (if not already).
3) Redwood infra to provision sandbox and share creds (ephemeral).

Karthik — adding you for security/ops checklist. Marissa — can you capture the operational runbook?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP-draft-20261127.pdf (stub)
From: dl-licensing@acme.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Jay Hayes <jay.hayes@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot data exchange — sample logs & prompt packs

Soojin,

We have a standard mutual NDA in place but need the pilot-specific MPA (data handling addendum) completed. Two quick asks:
1) Please confirm there will be no long-term retention beyond the pilot window unless both parties agree in writing.
2) Confirm that logs and any intermediate artifacts will not be used to train or improve models outside the pilot.

If those are confirmed, we can counter-sign the attached NDA and share the sample payload by COB Monday.

Regards,
Acme Data Licensing Team
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Jay Hayes <jay.hayes@acme.com>, dl-licensing@acme.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot data exchange — security & access checklist

Hi Jay / Acme team,

Thanks — quick responses to the licensing asks: yes, Redwood will not retain or use the raw sample outside of the pilot evaluation unless Acme explicitly agrees. We can append a short Data Use Addendum to the NDA to make this explicit.

Operational notes:
- Transfer options: pre-signed S3 (recommended) or one-time SFTP drop. We will issue links that expire after 72 hours and rotate keys after intake.
- Sandbox retention: default 4-week access, logs retained 30 days, then automatic purge. We will provide audit logs including IP and user actions for the intake period.
- Model training: no training or offline use of the raw sample; any derived embeddings used during the pilot can be deleted on request.

For validation we will:
- Provide sandbox URL and a scoped API key with read-only access to the trial tenant.
- Share an intake checklist (sha256 on files, expected format) so Acme can confirm integrity.

Marissa — can you draft the intake-runbook and schedule the operational handoff call for Wed morning PST?

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Jay Hayes <jay.hayes@acme.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot data exchange — runbook and schedule

Hi all,

I've attached the intake runbook and a proposed schedule:
- Wed 09 Dec: S3 link issued and sample ingest validation (checksum + schema).
- Thu 10 Dec: Prompt-pack mapping + initial quality eval (small-batch).
- Week of 14 Dec: Full pilot ingestion and performance testing.
- Week of 28 Dec: Close review, results deck, and deletion confirmation.

Operational constraints / notes:
- Access will be limited to two Redwood service accounts and one solutions engineer.
- We will not persist raw transcripts beyond the pilot TTL; derived embeddings will be treated per the DUA.
- Any escalation to extend the pilot requires sign-off from Acme's licensing and Redwood's legal.

Attachments: intake-runbook-v1.docx (stub)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Customer Pilots | Redwood Inference
From: Jay Hayes <jay.hayes@acme.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot data exchange — runbook and schedule

Thanks everyone — looks good. We reviewed the MAP and the runbook internally; Acme confirms the following:
- We will share the redacted sample via presigned S3 (team will upload by Tue).
- NDA addendum accepted; license countersigned and returning the signed doc (attached: ndasigned-acme.pdf).
- Pilot start: 09 Dec as proposed.

One small request — please include an explicit line in the MAP that Redwood will revoke the API key and S3 access at the completion of the pilot and provide deletion receipts.

If that can be added, we are ready to go.

Best,
Jay
